en:
Honestly! You're quite the
rogue, Captain. If you find ruins
that look like they're hiding
treasures like this, you must
tell me sooner!
Speaking of ruins, I'm your girl!\nNow, let's press on with the\nexploration!

...Captain. I'm sorry. This is a
bit late, but... would it be
possible for me to withdraw
from this expedition?

(If they see I was controlled by
the Crimson Shield... no, even
worse, if they find out about
the Ancient Covenant...)
Oh my, whatever is the\nmatter? Is Mavelle-chan afraid\nof the dark?
Ah, no, it's not that...
...It's just that my past is...\nwell...
It can't be helped, then
I don't care what your past is
Let's agree not to look into\neach other's pasts
Thank you. In that case, I will\nhead back to the ship.
Mavelle-chan, it's dangerous to\ngo back alone. If you'd like, I\ncan escort you to the ship...
Oh, but we can't have your\npast being projected on the\nway there...
Sarah, I can manage on my\nown...
I know, let's do this! I'll blindfold\nyou and give you some\nearplugs for the trip!
Eh, wouldn't that actually make\nthings more dangerous for you,\nSarah?
If I use my Featherfolk sixth\nsense, I should be able to\nmanage...
Ah! Sarah, watch out, that's a\nwall!!

Wait, so if someone's past is
projected, everyone else
should close their eyes and
cover their ears?

That's a wonderful idea,
Captain! Meri and the others
told me there's a sign before
the past is projected.

When that sign occurs,
everyone except the one
seeing their past must close
their eyes and cover their ears.

We'll check on the person first,
and if they seem okay, we'll tell
everyone they can open their
eyes.
That way, Mavelle, you can\nexplore these ruins together\nwith us!
For my sake... I'm sorry,\nCaptain, Sarah.
I'm happy to hear you say that,\nbut...

Captain, you can't do that! No
matter how much trust exists,
everyone has a past they'd
rather not have revealed.

I'd hate for everyone to know
when I opened the front door
thinking it was the bathroom
and caused a frenzy in the
village!
...I think it's already too late\nsince you just told us that\nyourself...
Oh, you're right! I slipped up.\nPlease keep that a secret from\neveryone who isn't here!
So, how about we all agree not\nto look if someone else's past\nis being projected?
Meri and the others told me\nthere's a sign that appears\nbefore the past is projected.

When that sign occurs,
everyone except the one
seeing their past must close
their eyes and cover their ears.

We'll check with the person
whose past is shown first. If
they're okay, we'll tell everyone
to open their eyes.
That way, Mavelle can explore\nthese ruins together with us!
Thank you, Sarah.

That's a great idea! Meri and
the others told me there's a
sign that appears before the
past is projected.

When that sign occurs,
everyone except the person
seeing the past should close
their eyes and cover their ears.

We'll check with the person
seeing the past first, and if
they seem okay, we'll have
everyone else open their eyes.
Captain, Sarah... Thank you for\nyour concern.
Then, I'll go tell Celine to close\nher eyes too.
Ah...
This is the sign! Captain,\nplease close your eyes and\ncover your ears!
Hmm, being a Featherfolk must\nbe quite difficult.
Hehehe.
Everyone seems to be okay.\nYou may open your eyes.
The interval from the sign was\nso short, it made me panic.
I wonder if this is something\nthat happened on Edge's\nspaceship?
Oh, Celine, you've returned too!\nIt seems so!
What's so terrible?
It's about Sarah's people... the\nFeatherfolk.

Apparently, they practice
pure-bloodism to protect the
"Sacred Wings," so they can
only marry within their own
race.
There were similar things with\nminority groups back on Earth,\nbut I guess Roak has them too.
What?! Does that mean Sarah\ncan only marry someone from\nher village?!
That's right. Those are the\nrules.

Rules...? Are you truly okay
with that? You'll spend your
whole life with someone chosen
by your parents and your
village!
Yes, everyone in my village is\nso kind, so I'm sure I'll be\nhappy no matter who I marry.
No matter who... Sarah...\nThat's not how it works!

The Featherfolk are a very
rare race in Roak, so I believe
it is a rule meant to protect
their species.
So they sacrifice Sarah's life\njust to protect their species?!
Hey, Sarah! Think about this!\nAre you truly okay with that?!

I refuse to let my parents
choose my spouse. I want to
find him with my own eyes! A
man I can truly call my own...
Celine...
Celine. I don't believe Sarah is\nsacrificing herself.
What...? But she said she'd\nmarry anyone as long as it's to\nprotect her race!
Yes, anyone from the\nFeatherfolk village.

In other words, she will live
with the villagers, cherishing
the bloodline the clan has
protected to honor those who
built Featherfolk.
I believe that is the way of life\nSarah has chosen out of her\nlove for her clan.

You're right. It was my own
selfish assumption to say that
Sarah was being sacrificed for
her clan.

I'm sorry, Sarah. You have your
own way of living. It seems I
was forcing my own views upon
you.
No, no―Celine, you were just\nworried about my happiness.\nThank you.

Besides, Celine, there is no
need to worry. Everyone in the
Featherfolk village lives by
cooperating with one another.

Whether one marries or not,
everyone in the village is like
one big family from the very
beginning.

Mavelle is right. I wouldn't even
notice if I accidentally fell
asleep in my neighbor's
bedroom!
Surely that's just you, Sarah...?
Even so, Mavelle, you sure\nknow a lot about the\nFeatherfolk village!
She's right. From what I've\nheard, it sounds like a very\nisolated village...
Eh, ah, um... I... I heard it from\nIoshua! He talked about his\nhometown during our travels!!
Oh, I see. You two really are\nclose, aren't you? I'm afraid\nErys might get jealous.
(Phew... I'm glad I managed to\nbluff my way through that...)
Ugh...!
Waaah! It's an omen! Celine,\nclose your eyes!
Eh!?
If it's not too much trouble,\nmay I join you?
...Yes.
Thank you, Sarah. It seems my\nfears were unfounded.
I'm glad to hear that!

Glad is not the word! What do
you mean, suddenly running
into me with your eyes
closed?! You made me trip!
I'm so sorry... It was all so\nsudden...
You said there were\ncircumstances... I expect a\nproper explanation later!
So, Mavelle. Am I correct in\nassuming this is part of your\npast?
Yes. These are memories from\nafter my journey with Lati and\nthe others ended.
Something occurred to me\nrecently.
Please don't laugh... but\nsomehow, I see glimpses of my\nsister in you...
What's wrong? Why are you\ncrying...?
Ah, I-I'm sorry...
And so, the two of them\ndecided to continue their\njourney together.
Yes.
(I will seek atonement on this\njourney, so that one day, I can\ntell my brother everything...)
I've heard that in these ruins,\nmemories related to the\npresent often manifest...
Since Ioshua's memories\nsurfaced while we were talking\nabout marriage, could it be...?
Eh! Please don't misunderstand\nin such a strange way!!

We were talking about the
Featherfolk village, and that's
why I remembered things about
Ioshua!
And yet, you insisted on joining\nour search for your sister... I\ncan't help but be suspicious!

N-No, that's not it! I only
offered to join because I
understand the desire to
search for someone precious
to you!

Hehe, your desperate attempts
to cover it up only make you
look more suspicious. What do
you think, Sarah?
Yes... I can see what Celine is\ngetting at.
Hmph, I knew it!
Even you, Sarah...

I think I understand Celine's
point―the desire to marry
someone you've personally
decided is "the one.
What? Are we really still talking\nabout this!?
I never would have thought\nsuch things in the past.

But meeting Edge and the
others has shown me so many
wonders, beyond the village
and even beyond the skies...

Now, I want everyone in our
village to be free to go out into
the world and find their own
excitement.
Sarah...
Of course, protecting what our\npeople hold dear is also\nimportant...
You mean embracing new\nwinds while still respecting\ntradition.
Yes, exactly.
It won't be an easy path, but I\nfeel like you can do it, Sarah.

(With those clear eyes, she
reformed our village and
showed the Featherfolk a new
future... the "Sacred Wings"...)

(The reason Aunt Sarah is the
way she is in our era is thanks
to her journey with Edge and
the others.)

That's why, Mavelle, if you love
him, I think it's perfectly fine to
marry Ioshua without worrying
about him being a Featherfolk.
What?! Sarah!
She is right. Mavelle, it is\nimportant that you do not give\nup!
Honestly! You two, please stop\nmisunderstanding everything!!

No treasure in these ruins...
but it's an interesting place to
learn more about our
companions.
But we haven't been able to\nsee Celine's memories yet.
That's true. I'm actually looking\nforward to seeing what kind of\nmemories will be replayed...

They say it doesn't just show
memories, but can sometimes
project things from an unseen
future, too.
I wonder if the figure of my\ndestined man might be shown?
Hm?
It's an omen!
Oh, if it isn't Chris?
Hey, Celine. What a\ncoincidence.

It's a shame, but when you're
lying in wait like you just did,
wouldn't you say that's not
exactly a coincidence?
Haha... You're harsh.

This brings back memories...
Wait, why are all three of you
covering your ears and closing
your eyes? Please, look!
No, it's just that we can't go\npeeking into your past without\npermission, Celine...

Ah, so that's why Sarah
bumped into me when Mavelle's
memories were being projected
earlier.
I don't mind if you watch. It\nlooks like Krosse's castle town.
The scene has changed. Is this\nan alleyway?
It was the first time. To be\ngazed at with such a direct\nlook in his eyes...
Celine.
And... it was the first time I had\never heard such honest words.
A single, unadorned sentence...
It feels quite romantic, doesn't\nit?

Hmm, I wonder what's going
on? I have no memory of
having a conversation like this
with Chris.
Perhaps it's something that is\nabout to happen.
That's impossible. This man is a\npenniless vagabond who was\ndining without paying!

As I thought, if I am to fall in
love, I prefer a man with a
skilled trade and financial
stability.
...Though I must admit, his face\nisn't half bad.
Even so, it's impossible!
Oh... what has come over me?\nI've never felt this way before.
Don't run away, Celine. I don't\nwant to let you go.
Please. Save me, Chris.
Look at them hugging so\ntightly! They're such a sweet\ncouple!
W-w-w... W-what on earth is\ngoing on!?
Ah, it looks like the scene is\nchanging again!
Soldier: What are you brats\ndoing here?!

Soldier: Prince Krosse's
wedding is currently in
progress. Do you have any idea
of that?!
I have something to say to that\nPrince.
Soldier: What!?
Just let us through!
Eh, Rena... And Prince\nKrosse...!?
Who are you people!?
Soldier: Seize those two!
Chris!

Priest: Do you, Rosaria R.
Lacoule, take Crowzer T.
Krosse as your husband, and
swear to love him unchangingly
for all your life?
I do.
No... it's too far, I can't hear\nanything!
Priest: Very well. ...Now,\nCrowzer T. Krosse.

Priest: Do you, Crowzer T.
Krosse, take Rosaria R.
Lacoule as your wife and
swear to love her unchangingly
for all your life?
No... no, no! Chris... Chris!!
Is this what she meant? When\nCeline says "Chris," she's\nreferring to Prince Krosse...
It looks like Celine-san crashed\nthat prince's wedding\nceremony!
...What is the meaning of this? I\nhave absolutely no memory of\nsuch an event...
And to think that I would be\nthe one to interrupt a prince's\nwedding...
What could have possibly\nhappened to cause this...
Are you alright, Celine-san?\nYou look completely stunned\nby all of this...
Eleyna-san mentioned\nsomething about this before.

She said an oracle is just one
possibility for the future. She
suspects a similar power might
be at work in these ruins.
So this is one of the possible\nfutures that might happen to\nCeline-san.
Marrying a prince sounds just\nlike a fairy tale! Celine-san,\nyou're going to be a princess!
I refuse to be a princess! A\nroyal castle sounds far too\nsuffocating!
So as long as it isn't\nsuffocating, you'll be fine?
Eh... Th-that's, how should I put\nit...?
Hehehe. Now I'm getting a little\nexcited!
A-anyway! I have no intention\nof being swayed by such\nthings.
The person I love for the rest\nof my life is someone I shall\nchoose with my own eyes!

This story has come to an end.
We plan to release various
other stories in the future.
Please look forward to them.
